num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the undirected graph.
target_density: <float> Target probability that an edge exists between any pair of vertices in the Erdos-Renyi random graph.
actual_density: <float> Realized fraction of possible edges present in the generated graph.
num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the graph.
greedy_clique_size: <int> Size of a clique found by a greedy heuristic, serving as a known lower bound on the maximum clique size.
greedy_clique: <list[int], length greedy_clique_size> Vertex indices belonging to the greedy heuristic clique.
vertices: <list[int], length num_vertices> List of all vertex indices in the graph.
edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Each entry is a pair of vertex indices representing an undirected edge, with the smaller index first.
adjacency_list: <dict, key: '{vertex}'> For each vertex, the sorted list of neighboring vertex indices that share an edge with it.
